description: List every deadline rule set 1Court covers, with rule counts and scope. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county. Use the rule_set ids with search_rules, get_rule and calculate_deadline.
name: list_rule_sets
